releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.5 (Intelligent Add Text Snap & 100% Bold Alignment)
changelog:
⚡ Flawless Add Text & Line-Snapped Typography Alignment:
• Intelligent Snap-To-Line in Add Text Mode: Tapping near any existing text line automatically locks the insertion box to the exact median height, baseline, and font size of neighboring words ('For Archana' -> 'Kumar').
• Line-Level Bold & Ink Inheritance: Added text automatically inherits bold weight (700) and pure jet-black ink (#000000) from the line.
• Heavy Bold Stroke Widening: Bold text in TextRenderer uses algorithmic outline expansion and FILL_AND_STROKE to match authentic computer-printed laser/inkjet Arial Bold.
• Overwhelming Line Bold Consensus: When neighbor words are bold, the added word is guaranteed to match with 100% consistency.
